de: Emperor Domitian is assassinated as a result of a plot by his wife Domitia and two Praetorian prefects. Nerva is then proclaimed as his successor.

dz: 内尔瓦被怀疑是多米蒂安之死同谋,被元老院宣布为皇帝. 参议院随后废除了多米蒂安通过的法律并下令将他的雕像摧毁.
de: Nerva, suspected of complicity of the death of Domitian, is declared emperor by Senate. The Senate then annuls laws passed by Domitian and orders his statues to be destroyed.
